segments.he: הָאוֹמֵר: ״וּמִזַּרְעֲךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לְהַעֲבִיר וְכוּ׳״. תָּנָא דְּבֵי רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל: בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּא עַל הַגּוֹיָה וְהוֹלִיד מִמֶּנָּה בֵּן לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה הַכָּתוּב מְדַבֵּר.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: If «one says,» while translating the verse: «“And you shall not give any of your seed to set them apart to Molekh”» (Leviticus 18:21): And you shall not give any of your seed to impregnate an Aramean woman, he is silenced with rebuke. A Sage «from the school of Rabbi Yishmael taught:» One who translates the verse in this manner maintains that «the verse speaks of a Jew who has relations with a gentile woman and fathered from her a son» who will be raised to engage in «idol worship.»
